summary: Goldgroup Mining filed a 6-K attaching a Canadian Form 51-102F3 material change report covering the September 25, 2026 closing of a non-brokered private placement (the Canadian equivalent of a US private placement/PIPE): 33,382,326 units at US$3.65 per unit for US$121,845,490 gross, more than 60% above an initial US$75 million target. Each unit comprises one common share and one-half warrant; whole warrants strike US$5.10 to March 25, 2028. Finders received 5% cash commissions totaling US$4,219,785.04. Proceeds fund working capital and possible M&A; watch deployment and warrant overhang.
